verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. Yellow blocks sit across the woman photo, the second photo has shrunk to an unreadable sliver, and 'FREYA ANOUK' is split off above the headline while 'ONLINE TRAINING BY' is stranded at the bottom, so the credit line reads in the wrong order. Both also lose the full-bleed photo and leave large white dead zones between pieces of text. A is slightly less bad because its photo is a bit larger and the gaps between elements are a little less extreme; B's photo is smaller and its empty space is worse.
